judgments.concern: Width and height are params.pallet_width_m 1.20 and params.pallet_height_m 0.14, the EstimatePoseParams defaults cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype. PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults and does not declare them as ROS parameters. dataset_replay.launch.py passes those two launch values only to eval_recorder_node. EstimatePoseOutcome, PoseResult, and PalletPoseStamped have no width_m, height_m, or depth_m. PalletPoseStamped ends at deferred_source_indices, which publish_pose already fills from the admission split. publish_pose copies pose.tz into both pose positions. pose.tz is centre_r.z() from lift_point_from_plane_2d and apply_se3. publish_pose does not read params_ and does not receive the samples, so the three scalars have to be stored on the outcome before return. On the success path, samples.points_depth_frame, plane_d after orient_normal_toward_camera, the PlaneBasis, and best_pose are still locals. debug.chamfer_theta_rad is the only part of best_pose copied out. project_points_to_plane_2d is public and today runs on the plane inliers only; it accepts the full samples matrix. point_to_plane_distance is the signed residual. plane_inlier_mask keeps the absolute residual at or below plane_inlier_threshold_m, the Stage2Config default 0.005, and the node does not override stage2_cfg_. Points outside that slab remain in points_depth_frame. orient_normal_toward_camera leaves normal.z() <= 0, so the negation of the signed distance is positive on the far side and negative on the camera side. transform_points_2d is the public forward map: rows times R.transpose() with R = [[c, -s], [s, c]], then +(tx, ty). The inverse subtracts (tx, ty) and applies that row map at -theta, which is transform_points_2d with theta negated and translation zero. No caller in the pipeline does that. rotate_proto_into is the same rotation inside chamfer_detail. The factory test is absolute prototype x at most half of 1.20 and absolute prototype y at most half of 0.14, closed on the boundary. sample_rect_contour builds that outer rectangle at the origin and the holes at (±pocket_centre_offset_m, 0). Prototype2D stores the contour samples only. The package has no point-in-rectangle test, so a foot inside a pocket hole still lies inside this outer rectangle and is kept. The test is in prototype coordinates after that inverse. The kept contributions are a local array. The package has no step window. Sorting them, seeding at the contribution closest to zero, and growing while each step to the next kept contribution is at most pallet_height_m 0.14 can run before return. A tie for closest to zero has no rule in the proposal. depth_m is the greatest contribution in that window. sample_face_points does not fill gaps: it drops non-finite depths outside depth_min_m 0.3 and depth_max_m 5.0 and points whose RGB projection misses the eroded bbox. A gap larger than 0.14 ends the window, so a farther return stays out, and a face-only cluster leaves depth_m at the greatest attached contribution, on the order of the 0.005 inlier slab. An empty kept set has no seed. The proposal substitutes no second length and writes no flag. outcome.ok is already true on this path, and publish_pose still publishes PalletPoseStamped, so an empty set has no defined depth_m. A float64 on that message defaults to 0. The pass sits after ransac_plane_fit, the only use of rng_ in the call, and does not draw. make_failure returns before best_pose exists, and a failed estimate publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The failure diagnostic already carries the admission lists and no sizes. The empty-admission return and the depth_image_to_meters throw publish nothing. Stage 2 still runs once, on admission.admitted.front(). geometry_msgs/PoseStamped has no size fields. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich stores yaw, position, n_face_points, plane_inlier_ratio, and chamfer_cost_m, and the overlay sizes its quad from the recorder's own pallet_width_m and pallet_height_m.

Width and height are params.pallet_width_m 1.20 and params.pallet_height_m 0.14, the EstimatePoseParams defaults cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype. PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults and does not declare them as ROS parameters. dataset_replay.launch.py passes those two launch values only to eval_recorder_node. EstimatePoseOutcome, PoseResult, and PalletPoseStamped have no width_m, height_m, or depth_m, and no fork-centre fields. PalletPoseStamped ends at deferred_source_indices, which publish_pose already fills. publish_pose copies pose.tz into both pose positions and does not read params_. pose.tz is centre_r.z(). The two opening centres are not stored on Prototype2D. sample_rect_contour is private to prototype.cpp and places the holes at (±pocket_centre_offset_m, 0) with sides pocket_width_m 0.47 and pocket_height_m 0.10, the values this call passes. The centres are those parameters. Two points at (±params.pocket_centre_offset_m, 0), with the node default offset 0.28, are the centres this call already cuts. transform_points_2d, lift_point_from_plane_2d, and apply_se3 of camera_cfg.R_dr and camera_cfg.t_dr are the maps the face centre already takes: centre_2d is (best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty), the lift is centre_d, apply_se3 returns centre_r, and pose.tz is centre_r.z(). All three maps are affine. The midpoint of (±offset, 0) is the prototype origin, transform_points_2d sends that origin to (best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty), the lift of that point is centre_d, and apply_se3 of it is centre_r. The mean of the two RGB centres is therefore centre_r for every theta and every plane tilt, and the mean of their z is pose.tz. On a tilt the two z values differ from each other. Their mean stays pose.position.z, the scalar publish_pose already writes. depth_m defined as that mean republishes the face-centre optical range. The pass does not read samples.points_depth_frame or point_to_plane_distance. padding_m 0.80 remains the border rasterize_points_to_mask adds around the inlier box. The two centres themselves are absent from the outcome. best_pose.tx, best_pose.ty, and the PlaneBasis are locals, and debug.chamfer_theta_rad keeps only the angle, so the two lifts have to run before return and be stored on the outcome for publish_pose to copy. The negative-offset centre first is an order the message does not have. This pass does not draw from rng_. make_failure returns before best_pose exists, and a failed estimate publishes no PalletPoseStamped. The failure diagnostic stays the admission lists. The empty-admission return and the depth_image_to_meters throw publish nothing. Stage 2 still runs once, on admission.admitted.front(). geometry_msgs/PoseStamped has no size fields. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich stores yaw, position, n_face_points, plane_inlier_ratio, and chamfer_cost_m and does not read opening centres.

Width and height are params.pallet_width_m 1.20 and params.pallet_height_m 0.14, the EstimatePoseParams defaults cached_prototype already passes to build_default_pallet_prototype. PalletPoseNode leaves params_ at those defaults and does not declare them as ROS parameters. dataset_replay.launch.py states that pallet_pose_cpp_node does not expose the prototype sizes and passes pallet_width_m and pallet_height_m only to eval_recorder_node. EstimatePoseOutcome, PoseResult, and PalletPoseStamped have no width_m, height_m, depth_m, or has_dimensions. PalletPoseStamped ends at deferred_source_indices, which publish_pose already fills from the admission split. The estimator receives params and, on success, sets pose.tz to centre_r.z() from lift_point_from_plane_2d and apply_se3 before return. publish_pose already copies that scalar into pose.position.z on the geometry_msgs pose and on the rich pose. depth_m set to that scalar is the same optical-frame z. The pass does not read samples.points_depth_frame or a length along the normal. has_dimensions can default false on EstimatePoseOutcome. make_failure returns before any size is written, so the failure outcome stays false. publish_pose runs only when outcome.ok, so the published PalletPoseStamped carries has_dimensions true. The false value is never on that message. The failure diagnostic stays the admission lists and has no size flag. The empty-admission return and the depth_image_to_meters throw publish nothing. publish_pose has the outcome and does not read params_, so the four fields have to be on the outcome for the rich copy. The geometry_msgs pose stays a header and a pose. Stage 2 still runs once, on admission.admitted.front(). Every success publishes the same width and height, because the node never changes params_. eval_recorder_node._on_pose_rich already stores pred_tz from pose.position.z and sizes its overlay from the recorder's own pallet_width_m and pallet_height_m. It does not read width_m, height_m, depth_m, or has_dimensions.
